notes.title: Spring Update 5.2: Quick Play, New UI, Outfits & More!
notes.notes:
As revealed in our previous news post, it's time for a big Spring update - read on for what's included in 5.2!

Fresh new UI
Internally, we called this Phase 2 of the UI overhaul. In our previous update, we improved our in-game UI and now you will see the rest of the UI re-design implemented.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/080605b2268111cd04341200364309c8cd0483b1.png

Demon Outfits
We're excited to bring you the next in our series of characters' demon form outfits - this time, it's Molly! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c8ef505ff75cad99f7b213e09955bfd51b2e5f3f.jpg

We've also tweaked April's demon outfit to add a face design in keeping with her appearance in The Manor. This upgrade will apply retroactively to those who have already purchased April's outfit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/0025286290de8924e6872a1537afddd0ac6630dc.png

Background Music
You can now choose which music to listen to in the menu. Enjoy switching between unique tracks all composed for DEVOUR. You can also purchase the DEVOUR soundtrack here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/929b6437c539d666bf871a2a5927af1836642152.png

Quick Play
The Quick Play button is here! This has been another popular request from players. You can now jump into a DEVOUR run faster than ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/88830c9a5cc2bd58e353b78daafc23dfeab9de87.jpg

VR Keyboard
An on-screen keyboard has been added to VR mode. If you haven't played DEVOUR in VR mode (and have the set up), give it a try - it takes the scares to a whole new level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/b94f09f4a380f1a85c47c8664198af01a46c1ba9.jpg

Upcoming Map
For those who missed it, our previous post teased some details about our upcoming map, The Carnival. Check it out now.

Full 5.2 changelog


 Phase 2 of the updated UI added
 New outfit added for Molly: 'Inpatient'
 April's Outfit 'Here Comes The Bride' upgraded
 Quick Play button added to server browser
 Main menu music selector added
 VR virtual keyboard for inputs added
 Removed the Perks toggle from lobby host settings. Players can still decide to play without perks if they desire. Note: The weekly challenge for winning without perks requires all players to not have any perks selected.
 Added a new animation for when a Dirty Head is Tamed on The Manor
 Fixed a bug where Sam or Nathan could get stuck when trying to take a shortcut
 Fixed a bug where Nathan could get stuck after knocking out on staircases
 Fixed a bug where Zara could sometimes get stuck after vomiting an egg
 Fixed a few thin floor colliders that allowed goats to fall through the floor on The Farmhouse basement (very edge case)
 Nathan now animates correctly if players win a game while he is mid-knockout

notes.title: Christmas Update: Easy Mode, Farmhouse update, new perks & more!
notes.notes:
'Tis the season to banish demons...

It's time for DEVOUR's annual Christmas Event, as well as lots of new, extra content! Read on for all the details of the event and what else is included in this update.

Farmhouse Texture Updates

The Farmhouse was our first map, and the one we launched with - developed by a tiny team, on a shoestring budget. It's had an impressive audio overhaul since then, but we thought it was time to give the environment some love too. We've been hard at work implementing new textures to bring the quality in line with our newer maps. Check out some of the results below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/aa63309f7e6464769bc3837ef86a6a781762b673.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/dfe22478c59a3f12ecce320a59dd0fbcbc673135.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/d905ee363dec315fffad21a42132206ddd43689f.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/671ac7dd43cc2715da51d4ce311031c5a8301a48.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/10ff27bd352096d6fe99ef06382f6114bf66665e.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ec6f1a9fb4818a422b38a78dc988de797b3bd525.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c37c09d5082756d2037d9b6a93468aa1b3b2e894.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/fc1649c20fb6ee052c07e7dd302d7acdcc7616f2.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2b5b8af2e65dbc4877015c2f4f911290fb2f4822.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/3a59802aef5d7ac6ab529ede57789b1817b04361.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4f14fedefbdacf5deaf9678fa526de75976b0270.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/907ff584a09ac396f5941e8e1928a43b5b7b545e.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/03dacd80ef2f45144c6147e5eff5471cd246993a.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2d689552cd1d38bfed2bda85db5eddc173417891.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/86c31d58ff5254a1eb0a19d2db5e3404a3b3cbe2.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ad157daa00ca7ec6ef28e1057d011c009c69af56.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/1ba13737072377eb0728e2886cff1fa6f34d3a41.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/cea493e014cd7dbebdb8b536d8059dc697f2c79a.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/614743cba4c52188da96a627d64d2af0e686e132.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/b1c57464443d35bba005242a85375579cca817b6.jpg

Easy Mode
An easier mode has been highly requested for a long time. We deliberately developed DEVOUR to be a challenging game, but we understand that some players want to play in a more casual way, and we think the new mode will be an accessible entry point for inexperienced players. 

Easy mode consists of:

Azazel speed is reduced by approximately 30%
UV charge regenerates at 200% speed
Approximately 25% less minions spawn
EXP gained from a match is reduced by 50%

UI refresh Phase 1: HUD
We've designed a crisp, new in-game HUD UI. Banishing Azazel and his minions never looked so pretty! This is Phase 1 of a complete UI refresh. We plan to release more improvements over the coming months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/80f3998c97044f969e5968f4668b42a25555dd4e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/0bd6d01b83ef27e6e39d4c8b1f96c23fb83d8f4a.jpg

New perks
Babe wake up, new DEVOUR perks just dropped...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/47c1cb99207dce0b38a9472ea158087eede9ba84.png
SPEED WALKER: Allows sprinting whilst using UV.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/1cedc5235d2cac2dadd5cc7eea513692edb7f9f3.png
TAMED: Ritual animals will not flee for 10 seconds after being dropped.

Christmas Event
During this year's event you'll have access to the following:

1) Bonus EXP
Grind those cult ranks with a generous 1.5x EXP for the duration of the event!

2) Little Helper Outfit
Unlock this super creepy new Christmas elf outfit for Molly by beating any map on Hard or Nightmare while playing as her (you'll retain the outfit permenantly). Those who miss out will be able to purchase the outfit after the event ends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/51162c937bda8ab9f0a3fafde92a75308c1b2aac.jpg

3) Christmas Robe
Unlock this bloody Christmas robe by collecting all 60 presents across the 6 maps. Time to go hunting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/49508aec5c56bc48731631ae977eb4e2d73a1376.jpg

Here Comes The Bride Outfit
This stunning new outfit for April, designed by our lead digital artist, is now available to purchase. We're hoping to develop this into a series and release each character's demon form outfit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/b1584c8a4356d3fc3c7848a34de9afa4f1772c12.jpg

Full 5.1 Changelog

Starts Christmas Event
Adds Easy Mode
Updates Farmhouse textures
Updates in-game HUD UI
Adds new perks Speed Walker and Tamed
Adds new outfits Little Helper and Here Comes the Bride
Adds Event Bonus section to the post-game awarded EXP tooltip
Adds Collectables section to global stats page
Clients can now invite friends to (public) lobbies
Fixes distorted outline for pigs on The Slaughterhouse
Players with high latency caught by a lump on the Manor that manage to escape through a mirror will now be released by the lump
Slightly tweaked the wording for the tutorial after picking up a battery
Cloth physics on character outfits are disabled when playing on Very Low
Weather is now correctly rendered on all intro/win/fail cutscenes
Fixed an issue where the Goat stat was being increased when burning a Book 
Russia and Russia East regions were removed. Apparently our server host had dropped those a while ago and they were actually running in Tokyo all this time. We obviously didn't get the memo!

notes.title: 4.3 Update: Extra perk slot, challenges, stats & much more!
notes.notes:
Hello, demon slayers!

We've dropped some awesome new content for our 4.3 update, but before we get into that, some news about our new upcoming map, The Manor.

Originally, we gave Q2 2024 (April - June) as the expected release date for the map. We need to delay its release until September 2024. To be transparent about why: during early playtesting, we found that April (possessed by Azazel), and the map itself, weren't working the way we had hoped. In general, it didn't feel scary enough, so we went back to the drawing board and we're now implementing some major improvements.

We know the delay will come as a disappointment to some of you, and we're genuinely sorry. That said, we never put out content unless we are proud of it. We're going to take the time we need to get the map right. We've always wanted to get our yearly map releases closer to the Halloween period, which we will now be able.

Please remember that we never charge for new content. We love DEVOUR, and we want to be able to continue making quality content for it. However, sometimes these things take more time than expected. We're working super hard on the game and will continue to do so for the forseeable future.

We're releasing a teaser trailer for the map soon, so keep an eye out!

Now, onto what's included in 4.3 - there's a lot to keep you busy over the summer!

Extra Perk Slot

We recently shared a perks feedback form with the community and we'd like to thank everyone who took the time to fill it in. There were so many useful thoughts and amazing ideas shared. As a result, we've overhauled the system, introduced some great new perks, and added a second perk slot, so players can equip two perks at the same time (a much requested feature in the feedback).

Note that all perks are split into 2 categories. You can only pick a single perk from each category.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/dd3bbf5977624c2b0b01e9eda91da2955de43d7c.gif

New Perks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/83854ea2950e6c4c85c56aa1310908e699856c30.jpg


INSPIRED: Ritual items are highlighted for 10 seconds after increasing map progress
KEYMASTER: Keys are highlighted through walls
PATIENT: UV charge regenerates 125% faster when in hiding spots
TEAMWORK: UV charge depletes 25% slower when within 5 meters of any alive player
STAY BACK: Movement speed of Azazel's minions is decreased by 50% when last player alive (co-op only)

Weekly Challenges

Regular challenges have been a popular request for a while now, and we've been hard at work implementing something that we hope will give you even more reason to jump into a DEVOUR run!

Challenges reset every Wednesday (UTC time). Each challenge is tied to a specific map and difficulty, with one for each difficulty mode. Challenges can only be completed once. You'll be granted a large chunk of EXP for completing a challenge and finishing a map (win or lose). If you leave a game early, you'll lose all challenge progress you gained during that game and won't gain any EXP. You can access the list of challenges from the main menu or Lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/42bb147d72d2c9dd3f577c3ef96075a33ccce70b.gif

Player Statistics

Global player statistics have been added to the game. You can access these from the Options menu. There were a few stats which we had not been tracking properly up until now so you'll notice some of your stats will start from 0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c43614ed1713b29f2e6d004706ee77c14c5888d6.gif

Nameplates

You can now toggle on Nameplates from the Options menu. They will not render through walls and are only visible up to a certain distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2948d06b3b2cf0ad77edc5be5a9dc4f9fd10ffdd.gif

New Emotes

4.3 also introduces 5 new dance themed character emotes - if you ever wanted to twerk as Zara or do the snake as Kai, now you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4923c0b48d6395b1021eefa37b35ff5283ca7057.gif

Outfits & Flashlight Skins

Check out these fun, fresh new outfits for the Cultist and Zara, and two awesome new flashlight skins. 

Note: Zara's 'Screamer' outfit and the 'Glitterbomb' flashlight skin are only available with the Supporter's Edition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/957fdbcbe765b70d2f7bba2eb1c985b4b495cade.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/15a8f0e009dfe56e84f3745924379790e95910fb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4efebe0a2ae1f9e2741d38b0ec516b22dcdb6fe4.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/bfe365ea602a2e77fe790891ecb250fd1e1753fa.jpg

Closing 3 regions

We are dropping regions South Africa, India and Canada from the server browser. These regions were barely being utilized and so it should also help in funneling more players into a more populated region. Note that actual gameplay for Devour is handled directly between the host player and clients so once you're in a game together it doesn't matter which region you hosted on.


Full 4.3 Changelog


Adds new Weekly Challenges
Adds a second Perk slot so you can equip 2 perks at the same time
Adds new lifetime Player Statistics (some only tracked from 4.3 onwards)
Adds option to show Nameplates above players
Adds subtle screen effect when any speed related perk activates
Adds option to Disable Perks for the host
Vegetation will now move when players walk through it
Players with the same character picked will no longer spawn at the same spawn point
Pressing Enter key when in a Lobby will now open the text chat box
Map names are now translated correctly in the Lobby
Perks Repellent, Field Medic and Immune now show the correct percentages (no change to in-game behaviour)
Some fixes to Lobby UX for gamepads
Jump Scare vocals and impact SFX volumes are now linked to the Master Volume slider (previously, it was just the impact sound)
5 new perks
2 new flashlights
2 new outfits
5 new dance emotes
Drops South Africa, India and Canada regions

Phew, that was a lot! Rest assured, we're still hard at work on The Manor, and we'll keep you updated on its progress. In the meantime, enjoy 4.3 and, as always, hold onto your goats.

notes.title: The Slaughterhouse: Development Update
notes.notes:
In a previous news post, we shared concept art for our upcoming map The Slaughterhouse, as well as some images of new assets. This time, we're updating you on the progress of the map environment itself, as well as some of the lore. 

Nathan's Past
We know a lot of players like Nathan's backstory, and The Slaughterhouse reveals a bit more: in his early 20s, before training as a chef, Nathan worked at the slaughterhouse before quitting dramatically due to the psychological stress of the job, as well as mounting pressure from his fellow colleagues. In The Slaughterhouse, Nathan has returned to his first work place to summon Azazel and exact bloody revenge.

A Brutal Experience
With this map, our developers have been hard at work creating an experience that is focused on physical/body horror, and exposes the player to some shocking, bloody moments. The gritty, gory map design, assets and character models all contribute to this effect, as well as some truly spine-tingling voice acting, sound effects and ambient audio. The Slaughterhouse is also smaller than our previous map The Town, and hearkens back to the dark, claustrophobic feel of our original map, The Farmhouse.

We can reveal that there will be new mechanics, and players will definitely be kept busy working out how to put everything in place in order to defeat a demonically possessed Nathan. We'll share further details upon release. The Slaughterhouse will be a brutal map to beat in general, and whether you're playing co-op or solo, we're excited to see how you all approach it on the various difficulty levels. Check out the screenshots below for a taste of what to expect (click to enlarge):


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/67095e54603b48fa19ad523c33d778c4509fbe2b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/6f891ef62cdec7d93402342e53028eba606ed6b6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/66e58a9ef2d1de47d8e1a636cb1d37d4624361bc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/bf629f97c2b419f3fabafc7dc35a957fe223aa7a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/76baa680a76e0a7cea793dd80e8c3141e8435363.jpg

The Slaughterhouse update will also introduce two new perks, a new flashlight, a new map collectable, and a variety of unlockable robes. Again, we'll reveal more info about these upon release.

Release Date
Currently, we are planning to release The Slaughterhouse in March 2023, if all continues to go smoothly. We can't give you an exact date yet because we don't have one, but we can confirm that we've entered the internal playtesting stage and that we're also working on a trailer. We'll update you with a precise release date as soon as we can.

Thank you for your continued patience as we prepare The Slaughterhouse for release. Your support really motivates us.

notes.title: Upcoming Schedule: An Important Update
notes.notes:
Real talk: the COVID-19 pandemic affected us all in one way or another, and for health related reasons, some of our core team have been forced to take a step back from the process of developing DEVOUR. This means that there will be a significant delay in releasing our next map, which was scheduled to drop this September. Rest assured that we're still working on the map, but we're now looking at a release date of sometime in 2023. Since we're delaying the release of the new map, we're also delaying the price bump.

We know this will come as a disappointment to many of you. We haven't made this decision lightly, and we ask for your understanding and patience as the team adapts to the situation and makes the decisions necessary to ensure the wellbeing of its developers and the longevity of DEVOUR. We're incredibly proud of the fact that within 18 months, as a small, independent team, we've released 4 separate maps, as well as full VR functionality and a Supporter's Edition.

We're still highly committed to bringing you more DEVOUR-themed frights - it's just going to take us a little longer this time. Until then, we're going to keep you updated on the development process by regularly sharing what various members of our team are up to behind the scenes.

We're still here, we're still super excited about the future of DEVOUR, and we're still grateful for our amazing community of players, fans and content creators. Thank you all.

The DEVOUR Team

Discord: https://discord.gg/q4tTa2Z

notes.title: VR Support Official Release
notes.notes:
Good things come to those who wait! We're excited to announce that DEVOUR is now fully VR capable! We know the DEVOUR community has been excited about the prospect of VR for the game and we've been working hard to bring full VR functionality to your favourite online co-op multiplayer horror.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/7372309146d2ad05e6a496abf8cd21c277121e02.jpg

For those who choose to play in VR mode, you will still be able to play with those who don't. And for those wondering about accessibility, you can play sitting down as well as standing. 

We're also pleased to let you all know that we'll be participating in the Steam VR Festival which runs from July 18th to July 25th, with the game on sale at 20% off. Just a reminder that our Supporter Edition releases August 4th, and you can find out more about that here. We also have some more DEVOUR news coming soon, so please keep an eye out for that.

As always, we feel incredibly blessed with our amazing DEVOUR community, and we're so excited to see all the content we know you'll bring being chased by demonic cultists in VR!

Official Soundtrack

This high quality OST allows you to enjoy the spine-tingling sounds of DEVOUR as you return to all your favourite game locations in this unique horror soundscape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/cacbc5504f0b02de6e2f4a6d054572f64cf2175a.jpg

The soundtrack's 21 tracks includes every chilling ambient score and main menu theme music from each of our currently released maps. We will continue to update the Soundtrack as we release new maps.

VR Support

We know many of you have been eagerly waiting to find out whether DEVOUR will implement VR, and we are excited to reveal that we will release VR support from 4th August 2022. This will be included in the main game with no additional purchase required if you already own the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/7372309146d2ad05e6a496abf8cd21c277121e02.jpg

If you are interested in helping us test the VR implementation ahead of release, head over to our Discord server and type +vr in any text channel. There is currently no official date for when the VR Beta will begin.

Price Increase

When DEVOUR was originally released, it only had a single map and as a small team we worked hard in our spare time alongside other commitments to ensure its successful launch.

However, in order to secure the future of DEVOUR and continue to bring you high-quality content, maps and features, we are increasing the base price of the game to $7.99 from 4th Aug 2022. This only applies to those who have not yet purchased the game. Existing owners of DEVOUR will never need to pay to play new maps.

We could not be happier that we've been able to build the DEVOUR community to the size it is today - it's truly a dream come to true for us. Thank you, each and every one of you, for your support.

Supporter Edition
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/271e8573c71bcb1b8c7f204ac0b3dec1ac585a01.png
We can also reveal that from 4th August 2022, a brand new Supporter Edition of DEVOUR will be available to buy on Steam as a way to enjoy unique DEVOUR content and further support the game's continuing development. This will include unique outfits and flashlight skins, as well as official art, and more!

Here is a sneak-peak preview of one of the unique cosmetics that will be available as part of the Supporter Edition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/4ca5e5cec07db2f344e3311830e7a473d677f65d.jpg

For more details, head over to the Steam Store Page and Wishlist Now!

Next Map

As always, we're busy working on a new map. We'll reveal more information when we're ready, but for now we can confirm that we are targeting September 2022 for a release date. Here's a teaser screenshot of one of the many gruesome locations you'll find in your next attempt to banish Azazel.

Please remember, creating new maps takes a huge amount of work, so please be patient with us as we do our best to bring you many more DEVOUR themed scares!

We are excited to roll out Update 2.2 for DEVOUR. It brings you new playable character Anna Puerta, as well as an incredible new cosmetic, flashlight skins, a new perk, farmhouse mechanic changes and more. Please scroll down to see the full changelog as well as details on the next map.

New Character: Anna Puerta

Anna Puerta has long been a fan favourite in DEVOUR lore, with her origins in DEVOUR's sequel game The Watchers. To clear up any confusion, Anna is a new, playable team member. You cannot play as possessed Anna (the demon) from the Farmhouse map. To play as Anna, you must complete Hard mode on any map.

We're also incredibly proud of the stunning new cosmetic, Mistress of Sin, that we're making available for Anna Puerta in this update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/cd37d2ec24bf5ce3d5f03ae19019c531fdccbdfa.jpg

New: Custom Flashlight Skins

Introducing Flashlight skins, because who says you can't look good while burning hordes of demonic minions? Some flashlight skins can be unlocked with in-game Ritual Tokens, and some are paid for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ad989acfec6f4a824241af7dfbe9c1058ab121cf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/c590037467d5cac69435d7083749b21d307d4605.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/488bd6b9c37e04d61c0324723beb0a4e7abe8257.jpg

New Perk: Supercharged

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/7e82fd8bdbb03a370eb80a1e07565e9a0ecc236f.jpg

New perk 'Supercharged', increases movement speed by 30% for 20 seconds after using a battery.

Farmhouse Changes

We've made 2 changes to The Farmhouse. 

The altar pit now requires a long interact to pour gasoline
Anna will now stand still to scream on a goat burn (unless she is actively chasing someone)

Please let me explain some of the reasons for why we are making these changes:
[olist]
Anna had a bug. She wouldn't stand still to scream like the other AI and this lead to situations where the audio logic would break. By fixing this, it made The Farmhouse easier and so the long interact acts as a natural counterbalance to this.
To balance the difficulty between maps. The Farmhouse is considerably easier than other maps (when using certain strategies) and so it ended up being the map that a large majority of players picked when grinding. We want all of our players to feel like they can play on any map.
To give certain perks more value outside of just The Inn.
To build more tension. The long interact mechanics were designed when creating The Inn and based on the positive feedback from our playerbase, we wanted to bring those mechanics into other maps. These small changes can have a very large impact on the fear factor that players, especially new ones, will experience in DEVOUR.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.3: Batteries, Revive Improvements and More!
notes.notes:
We're excited to release update 1.3 today. Please read below for more details on all of the changes.

Batteries

DEVOUR was designed to be a difficult game; due to the condensed length of each playthrough, we felt it was important to offer a challenging experience to players. However, now that DEVOUR has grown in popularity, we are noticing that the game can be a little too punishing for some players at times. Especially in Nightmare mode!

With that, we're releasing the new Batteries item as an optional game mechanic. Batteries can be used to instantly recharge your UV flashlight, as well as giving you a bonus amount of charge across all the difficulty modes. Check below the specifics.


 Batteries will only spawn on the map if enabled by the host.
 You can pick up and drop Batteries just like any other item.
 To consume a Battery, press the R key.
 Once consumed, the UV is fully recharged, with a bonus amount of charge. (Normal: 160%, Hard: 100%, Nightmare: 60%)
 Bonus UV flashlight charge is indicated with an orange colour and does not regenerate. 
 Batteries will respawn on the map after being consumed.
 There are a maximum number of batteries available in the game world at one time, including those held in players' hands but not yet consumed. (Normal: 4, Hard: 3, Nightmare: 2).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/d73c4332183c40a4468804c330dea0712f2ef07a.png

Revive improvements

If you've played DEVOUR, you've probably experienced a slighty janky behaviour when reviving. With this update, we completely reworked the revive logic to iron out some of these bugs.

What's next?

We know that most of you are interested to find out when DEVOUR's next map will release. Our aim is to release it before Halloween 2021. It will be our most ambitious map yet, and we will definitely share more details with you in the near future! As always, please keep in mind that we are a small team and creating new maps takes a huge amount of work.

We're also working on some other features which we want to release in the coming weeks. These include:

 New playable cult member 'April'.
 New character outfits (separate purchase)
 Farmhouse full audio redesign


1.3.0 Changelog

 Added Dutch and Indonesian language settings.
 Added Credits to the main menu.
 Added a new Mute Jump Scares audio setting.
 Fix for voice chat sometimes not working in lobbies.
 Displays a status message in the chat section when another player picks up a key.
 Fix for a hole in the world under the stairs near the Asylum fireplace.
 AI now correctly paths on the Asylum ritual area platform.
 Fixed a couple of spots on the Asylum map where Molly could not reach players.
 Fix for an edge case when Molly would scream on a client's machine but not on the host.
 Improved tutorials for AI staggering and calming down mechanics.
 Molly no longer renders red eyes constantly in Nightmare mode.
 Improvements made to both Farmhouse and Asylum environments to prevent being pushed through some walls when player collisions is turned on.
 Tweaks to the hosting lobby UI to allow for more settings to fit in future.
 Fixed a bug where you could pick Molly on The Asylum.
 Hosts now verify that clients own a legit copy of DEVOUR on Steam. This requires Steam to be initialized.

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer & Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks! I’m Joe, one half of the development team on DEVOUR. We’ve been busy working on the game and we’re now ready to share some more details with you.

Gameplay trailer

A game is only as good at its trailer, right? At least, thats what all the marketing folks tell me anyway. So we made one. Hope you like it.

[previewyoutube=dAsAqAyOFF0;full][/previewyoutube]

Features we’ve been working on
Let me introduce to you some of the major features we've been polishing over the last few months.

The gang

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/2407d6b733468e6c8c1232e56f7d4d832f32139d.jpg

You will take on the role of cult members (from left to right) Nathan, Molly, Zara and Sam. You’ll be happy to know we’ve added emotes (with voice overs) so that you can spam your favourite lines until you get kicked from Discord.

Anna

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/a889abe0de6b7244bc306283816e1c03afc26237.jpg

Meet Anna. She doesn’t usually look like this. Unfortunately for her, she messed up a ritual and now she’s having to deal with goat demon Azazel who’s using her body as a vessel.

Goats

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/ccd11385d5b214c3e251b5ee368d6b1d1dde1d69.jpg

Your primary goal in DEVOUR is to stop Anna before she takes you to hell with her. To do this you'll need to find gasoline, a fire pit, and enough sacrificial goats to burn.

Demons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/67a644c57575c0833c60c7f0da048ee48697f083.jpg

Relentless little buggers. These used to be your fellow cultists, but Azazel burned them and is now using their bodies to stop you.

Storm

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37243634/41c1e6320a4a8aa326461165ff5401ef28e7056d.png

Over the course of the game, you’re going to make Azazel very mad. Mad enough that he’ll start bringing down the wrath of zeus on you in our dynamically scaling storm system.

Frequently asked questions

What kind of game is DEVOUR?
We’re creating a survival horror experience that is fun to play with your friends. You can expect fast-paced gameplay where you will have to work together to defeat a possessed cult-leader.

How many players are supported?
DEVOUR can be played online with up to 4 players or offline in single-player mode.

When will it be released?
We’re targeting January 2021. However, we will release a public demo in October for the Steam Games Festival. This will provide you with a generous portion of the game for completely free. If you enjoy it, please show us your support and add DEVOUR to your wishlist!

How long will it be?
The initial release of DEVOUR will have a very palatable play time of roughly 1 - 2 hours.

How much will it cost? 
We want the game to be playable by you and all your friends, so we’ll be selling it for about the price of a Big Mac.

What about The Watchers?
If you’ve been brave enough to play The Watchers, you may be relieved to know that the gameplay style of DEVOUR is quite different. DEVOUR is technically a prequel to The Watchers. However, it is a bite-sized survival horror game for 1-4 players whereas The Watchers was a longer stealth puzzle game for 1-2 players. We like the universe that we built with The Watchers and wanted to build upon it.

Who makes this game?
I split the work with Luke Fanning. We also get a little help from my brother Andrew and sister Hannah. 

Stay in the loop
We hang out on Discord and Twitter.
